text: Fake-out test after LABT (Sarantis asked to find a way to spot the fake-out). Data: journal 1-min bars Oct 7-28, 1,270 stock-days. Event = first 1-min close below both VWAP and 9 EMA, within 3 h of the open, after the stock was up 15%+ from the open and still green (759 events). Outcome = which came first within 90 min: +15% or -10% from the break close. All: +15% first 19%, -10% first 23%. Stocks up 50%+ on the day (68): +15% first 21%, -10% first 57%. Tested: VWAP slope, number of VWAP crosses in the last 20 min, bar close position, sweep of the 20-min low, volume vs the first 5 min, distance from the day high. None separated fake-outs from real breaks reliably. LABT-like (50%+ mover, flat VWAP, 4+ crosses, volume under 0.6x the open): 3 cases (MNDR Oct 12, XLAB Oct 16, JZ Oct 8), all went -10% first. Re-entry on a reclaim of VWAP and 9 EMA within 15 min, 50%+ movers: 32 reclaims, +15% first 7 (22%), back under the break low or -10% first 20 (62%); with reclaim-bar volume 1.5x+: 6 up vs 9 stop. LABT Nov 5 at the 16:54 break: VWAP flat (+0.9% in 15 min), price had crossed VWAP 6 times since 16:39, volume 0.3x the opening 5 min, 20% off the high. Conclusion: no rule in this data flags the LABT dip as a fake-out at the time; the exit matched what happened most often on 50%+ movers.
